Ensemble of Hope#000.src: Meet up with your friends in room number {~} in hotel {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#003.src: {u}'s here? Good, that means we can-
Ensemble of Hope#003.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#007.src: Ugh. ZEPH! Get out of there already!
Ensemble of Hope#007.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#008.src: C...coming! Jeez, Rex, g...give a man his p- pr- privacy...
Ensemble of Hope#008.dst: 가, 가는 중이야! 참, Rex, 사, 사생활 좀 지, 지켜 줘...
Ensemble of Hope#008.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#010.src: Rex. I'm f...fine. St- stop asking me that.
Ensemble of Hope#010.dst: Rex. 나 괘, 괜찮아. 그, 그만 좀 물어봐.
Ensemble of Hope#010.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#011.src: Okay! Okay. Gods forbid I worry about you for even a second...
Ensemble of Hope#011.dst: 알았어! 알았다고. 1초도 걱정하면 안 된다 이거지...
Ensemble of Hope#011.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#012.src: Rex. You had something to tell us.
Ensemble of Hope#012.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#013.src: Right, okay, I'll get to it. These past few days, I have been plotting. I have something... serviceable, I think.
Ensemble of Hope#013.dst: 그래, 알았어, 말할게. 요 며칠 계획을 짰거든. 꽤... 쓸 만한 게 나온 것 같아.
Ensemble of Hope#013.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#014.src: So, to start with, let's lay out our goal - the destruction of the Crown, the Queen and her Sovereigns included.
Ensemble of Hope#014.dst: 우선 목표부터 정리하자. 왕실의 파멸. 여왕과 군주들까지 전부.
Ensemble of Hope#014.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#015.src: We won't be able to do it ourselves - we're only four people. And we definitely won't be able to do it if their eyes are on us the whole time!
Ensemble of Hope#015.dst: 우리끼리는 못 해. 겨우 넷이잖아. 게다가 계속 감시당하는 상태면 절대 불가능하고!
Ensemble of Hope#015.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#016.src: Sui and {u}, you two worked with the Canopy while you were in the {p}. Do you think they have the people and resources to help us?
Ensemble of Hope#016.dst: Sui랑 {u}, 너희 {p}에 있을 때 수관이랑 같이 일했지. 그쪽에 우릴 도울 인력이랑 자원이 있을까?
Ensemble of Hope#016.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#017.src: They do. They've... been fighting openly against the crown for years and haven't been caught. So... they know what they're doing.
Ensemble of Hope#017.dst: 있어. 몇 년이나... 대놓고 왕실이랑 싸우면서 한 번도 안 잡혔어. 그러니까... 뭘 하는지 아는 사람들이야.
Ensemble of Hope#017.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#018.src: Good, we'll want to get in contact then. And Yusanu is with them, anyway... it'll be good to see him again.
Ensemble of Hope#018.dst: 좋아, 그럼 연락해 봐야지. 어차피 Yusanu도 거기 있고... 다시 보면 좋겠다.
Ensemble of Hope#018.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#020.src: But, uh, moving on. Zeph, you went out earlier and gathered some information on the {p}, right?
Ensemble of Hope#020.dst: 어, 그건 그렇고. Zeph, 아까 나가서 {p} 정보 좀 모아 왔지?
Ensemble of Hope#020.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#021.src: Y- yeah! P...people around here seem v- v- very excited for th...the festival. The C- Cr- Crown is gonna be b...busy with preparations for a wh...while.
Ensemble of Hope#021.dst: 으, 응! 이, 이 근처 사람들은 추, 축제 때문에 엄청 들떠 있어. 와, 왕실은 한동안 주, 준비로 바, 바쁠 거야.
Ensemble of Hope#021.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#022.src: B- but, uh, Rex, y...you wanted me to- to ch...check out the Dam E- Elevator, right?
Ensemble of Hope#022.dst: 그, 그런데, 어, Rex, 나한테 대, 댐 승강기 좀 사, 살펴보라고 했지?
Ensemble of Hope#022.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#023.src: I did, yep. What's the guards situation like? Heavily guarded, lightly guarded... somewhere in between?
Ensemble of Hope#023.dst: 그래, 맞아. 경비는 어때? 삼엄해, 허술해... 아니면 그 중간쯤?
Ensemble of Hope#023.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#024.src: S...somewhere in be- between, I think. Cl...closer to lightly guarded. I don't th- think they're ex- exp- expecting an... a- an attack.
Ensemble of Hope#024.dst: 주, 중간쯤인 것 같아. 허술한 쪽에 가, 가까워. 고, 공격을 예, 예, 예상하는 것 같진 않아.
Ensemble of Hope#024.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#025.src: Perfect. Perfect, perfect, perfect... so! How do we all feel about committing some light terrorism today?
Ensemble of Hope#025.dst: 완벽해. 완벽해, 완벽해, 완벽해... 자! 오늘 가벼운 테러 좀 해 보는 거 어때?
Ensemble of Hope#025.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#026.src: Okay, curb the enthusiasm a little. Let me explain why, first.
Ensemble of Hope#026.dst: 좋아, 흥분은 좀 가라앉히고. 이유부터 설명할게.
Ensemble of Hope#026.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#027.src: Ev- ever the optimist... R- Rex, why do you w...want to take the e- el-... the elevator?
Ensemble of Hope#027.dst: 여, 역시 낙천가야... R, Rex, 스, 승강기는 왜... 왜 점령하려는 거야?
Ensemble of Hope#027.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#028.src: Like we haven't done worse already... um, why the elevator, Rex?
Ensemble of Hope#028.dst: 더한 짓도 해 놓고 새삼... 음, 왜 승강기야, Rex?
Ensemble of Hope#028.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#029.src: We need to get the Crown's eyes off of us. They won't expect us to try to return to the {p} - why would we? The enemy is right here.
Ensemble of Hope#029.dst: 왕실의 눈을 우리한테서 돌려야 해. 우리가 {p}에 돌아갈 거라곤 생각 못 하겠지. 적은 바로 여기 있으니까.
Ensemble of Hope#029.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#030.src: So what happens when we do? They'll start thinking. Why are we doing it? What do we have to gain?
Ensemble of Hope#030.dst: 그럼 막상 돌아가면? 고민하기 시작하겠지. 왜 저러지? 뭘 노리는 거지?
Ensemble of Hope#030.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#031.src: They'll start to pay attention to that elevator. And, if we're lucky, less attention on what we're actually doing.
Ensemble of Hope#031.dst: 그럼 승강기에 신경을 쓸 거고, 운이 좋으면 우리가 진짜 하는 일엔 덜 신경 쓰겠지.
Ensemble of Hope#031.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#032.src: ...and, well, maybe if we're fast, we could bring some friends up from Auburn to us. We could use all the help we can get.
Ensemble of Hope#032.dst: ...그리고, 음, 빠르면 Auburn에 있는 친구들을 여기로 데려올 수도 있어. 도움은 많을수록 좋잖아.
Ensemble of Hope#032.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#033.src: Th...that- that sounds nice... it- it's been s...so long already...
Ensemble of Hope#033.dst: 그, 그거 좋다... 버, 벌써 너, 너무 오래됐어...
Ensemble of Hope#033.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#035.src: Sui... do you think you and Zeph could handle getting the rest of the Leaves up here? Zeph'll need someone who knows how to find the Canopy, and I need {u} with me.
Ensemble of Hope#035.dst: Sui... Zeph랑 같이 남은 잎새들을 데려올 수 있겠어? Zeph한텐 수관 찾는 법 아는 사람이 필요하고, {u}는 나랑 같이 가야 해.
Ensemble of Hope#035.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#038.src: Well, we'll all be going to take control of the elevator anyway. We can... talk more there.
Ensemble of Hope#038.dst: 뭐, 승강기 점령은 어차피 다 같이 가니까. 자세한 얘긴... 거기서 하자.
Ensemble of Hope#038.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#039.src: {u}, after we've don that, I'll need you to take me to the Canopy. I want to familiarize myself with their leadership, and start working on an actual plan.
Ensemble of Hope#039.dst: {u}, 그게 끝나면 나를 수관에 데려가 줘. 지도부랑 안면도 트고, 제대로 된 계획을 짜기 시작하고 싶어.
Ensemble of Hope#039.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#040.src: Okay! I think that's everything. Let's all get ready, then head to that elevator on the southern side of the dam!
Ensemble of Hope#040.dst: 좋아! 이 정도면 다 된 것 같아. 다들 준비하고, 댐 남쪽 승강기로 가자!
Ensemble of Hope#040.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#043.src: Hi, {u}. Ready to fight more of the crown's soldiers?
Ensemble of Hope#043.dst: 안녕, {u}. 왕실 병사들이랑 또 싸울 준비 됐어?
Ensemble of Hope#043.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#047.src: We... have Rex and Zeph back. We're going to reunite with the people we left behind in Auburn. We're going to meet back with the Canopy.
Ensemble of Hope#047.dst: Rex랑 Zeph를... 되찾았어. Auburn에 두고 온 사람들이랑 다시 만날 거고. 수관이랑도 합류할 거야.
Ensemble of Hope#047.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#049.src: Really? And why would that be?!
Ensemble of Hope#049.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#050.src: It's not like- n-not like someone's MISSING! OR ANYTHING!!
Ensemble of Hope#050.dst: 누가 사라지기라도- 사, 사라지기라도 한 것도 아니고! 안 그래?!
Ensemble of Hope#050.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#051.src: So- s-so maybe I'm not. But it doesn't matter. We have things we need to get done, {u}! I don't have time to- to feel not fine!!
Ensemble of Hope#051.dst: 그, 그래 안 괜찮을지도 몰라. 근데 상관없어. 우린 할 일이 있잖아, {u}! 안 괜찮을- 여유 같은 거 없어!!
Ensemble of Hope#051.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#053.src: Don't push this... please? Just... let's follow Rex's plan.
Ensemble of Hope#053.dst: 더 캐묻지 마... 응? 그냥... Rex 계획대로 하자.
Ensemble of Hope#053.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#054.src: It's... fine. Solid plan, I guess.
Ensemble of Hope#054.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#055.src: I couldn't think of anything better at least, so...
Ensemble of Hope#055.dst: 적어도 난 더 나은 건 생각 못 했으니까...
Ensemble of Hope#055.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#056.src: And, um, I'm not the- the tactician, anyway. I'm... glad I don't have to worry about that anymore.
Ensemble of Hope#056.dst: 그리고, 음, 난 어차피 전술가도- 아니고. 이제 그런 걱정 안 해도 돼서... 다행이야.
Ensemble of Hope#056.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#059.src: I... don't really want to face Yusanu again. After... um. You know.
Ensemble of Hope#059.dst: Yusanu를... 다시 마주하기 싫어. 그 일... 이후로. 알잖아.
Ensemble of Hope#059.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#060.src: But... I have to do it eventually. So.
Ensemble of Hope#060.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#061.src: Yeah. Let's... get a move on.
Ensemble of Hope#061.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#062.src: ...ready for phase one of the plan, {u}? Let's pack up quickly and head out.
Ensemble of Hope#062.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#064.src: You know... still awful. But, uh... better, I guess.
Ensemble of Hope#064.dst: 그게... 아직 엉망이야. 그래도, 어... 나아진 것 같아.
Ensemble of Hope#064.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#065.src: I haven't left the hotel these past few days... but even just getting real food has felt like... like a gourmet meal!
Ensemble of Hope#065.dst: 요 며칠 호텔 밖에 안 나갔는데... 제대로 된 음식만 먹어도... 무슨 고급 요리 같더라!
Ensemble of Hope#065.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#066.src: It's... hm. I've tried to not really... think about it too much. I'll have time for that when we're not still in danger.
Ensemble of Hope#066.dst: 그건... 음. 너무 깊이... 생각하지 않으려고 해. 위험에서 벗어나면 그때 생각할 시간이 있겠지.
Ensemble of Hope#066.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#067.src: But, Zeph... he's been isolating himself. Him and Sui both!
Ensemble of Hope#067.dst: 근데 Zeph가... 혼자 틀어박혀 있어. Sui도 그렇고!
Ensemble of Hope#067.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#068.src: Sigh... it's hard. Whenever I talk to him, he tries to put on his regular happy persona, but...
Ensemble of Hope#068.dst: 하아... 힘들어. 말을 걸면 평소처럼 밝은 척하는데, 그게...
Ensemble of Hope#068.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#069.src: I don't know. Obviously things have changed - I don't think you get out of - ha, what was it, weeks? - of imprisonment unaffected.
Ensemble of Hope#069.dst: 모르겠어. 뭔가 달라진 건 분명해. 그렇게- 하, 몇 주였지? 갇혀 있다 나오면 멀쩡할 리가 없지.
Ensemble of Hope#069.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#070.src: ...he's resilient. Sui too. We'll be able to work past this. It's just... going to take time.
Ensemble of Hope#070.dst: ...걘 강해. Sui도. 우린 이겨낼 수 있어. 그냥... 시간이 걸릴 뿐이야.
Ensemble of Hope#070.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#071.src: Still workshopping it! I have a couple of different ideas, but...
Ensemble of Hope#071.dst: 아직 다듬는 중! 몇 가지 아이디어는 있는데...
Ensemble of Hope#071.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#072.src: Well, it's hard to know which will work without knowing what the Canopy has. Too many different things to consider.
Ensemble of Hope#072.dst: 수관이 뭘 가졌는지 모르니까 뭐가 먹힐지 알기 어려워. 따질 게 너무 많아.
Ensemble of Hope#072.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#073.src: When we join up with them, I'm hoping I can fill in the gaps. And... I guess, get their opinions on it, too.
Ensemble of Hope#073.dst: 합류하면 빈틈을 채울 수 있으면 좋겠어. 그리고... 그쪽 의견도 들어 보고.
Ensemble of Hope#073.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#074.src: So- all that to say, I've got nothing for you! For now. I'll tell you later, okay?
Ensemble of Hope#074.dst: 그러니까- 결론은, 지금은 해 줄 말이 없다는 거! 일단은. 나중에 말해 줄게, 알았지?
Ensemble of Hope#074.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#076.src: I... don't know what to do. I really, really don't.
Ensemble of Hope#076.dst: 나... 어떻게 해야 할지 모르겠어. 진짜, 진짜 모르겠어.
Ensemble of Hope#076.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#077.src: We've... ugh, we've all lost people. Lots of Leaves got arrested for... this or that, over the years. It sucked, but... it happened.
Ensemble of Hope#077.dst: 우린... 으, 다들 누군가를 잃었어. 몇 년간 잎새도 이런저런 이유로 많이 잡혀갔지. 끔찍했지만... 그런 일이 있었어.
Ensemble of Hope#077.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#078.src: ...it's never been this bad before. Never anyone this close. I mean... sigh. Syndra and Mora. Gods.
Ensemble of Hope#078.dst: ...이렇게까지 심했던 적은 없어. 이렇게 가까운 사람은. 그러니까... 하아. Syndra랑 Mora. 세상에.
Ensemble of Hope#078.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#079.src: I want to help her get through this, but... she's closing herself off. And... we're still not home free just yet.
Ensemble of Hope#079.dst: Sui가 이겨내게 돕고 싶은데... 마음을 닫아 버렸어. 게다가... 아직 안전한 것도 아니고.
Ensemble of Hope#079.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#080.src: ...when it's over. When it's over. Everything will be okay when it's over.
Ensemble of Hope#080.dst: ...다 끝나면. 다 끝나면. 끝나기만 하면 다 괜찮아질 거야.
Ensemble of Hope#080.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#083.src: I'm r-ready to see my old friends again... I miss Kaio.
Ensemble of Hope#083.dst: 옛 친구들을 다, 다시 볼 준비 됐어... Kaio가 보고 싶어.
Ensemble of Hope#083.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#084.src: Was there s-something on your mind?
Ensemble of Hope#084.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#085.src: Ah... I... I don't want to lie to you.
Ensemble of Hope#085.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#086.src: So... I'm not d-doing great. Everytime I... I close my eyes I s-see that... face. The S-sovereign...
Ensemble of Hope#086.dst: 그러니까... 나 별로 괘, 괜찮지 않아. 눈을... 감을 때마다 그... 얼굴이 보, 보여. 그 군, 군주가...
Ensemble of Hope#086.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#087.src: Everytime I close my e-eyes I feel all that pain. All of it! All the m-memories!
Ensemble of Hope#087.dst: 눈을 가, 감을 때마다 그 고통이 다 느껴져. 전부! 그 기, 기억이 전부!
Ensemble of Hope#087.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#088.src: I was... okay with it all e-ending there.
Ensemble of Hope#088.dst: 그땐... 거기서 다 끄, 끝나도 괜찮았어.
Ensemble of Hope#088.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#089.src: I know that i-it's over. I know Gikyo is dead but... their ghost still h-haunts me.
Ensemble of Hope#089.dst: 끄, 끝난 건 알아. Gikyo가 죽은 것도 알지만... 그 망령이 아직 나를 따, 따라다녀.
Ensemble of Hope#089.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#090.src: I think it's a s-solid plan.
Ensemble of Hope#090.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#091.src: I j-just wonder how many from the Leaves in the Wind are willing to a-actually come all the way here.
Ensemble of Hope#091.dst: 바람 속 잎새에서 정말 여기까지 와 주려는 사람이 얼마나 될지 그, 그게 궁금할 뿐이야.
Ensemble of Hope#091.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#094.src: Well, here we are. The dam really is something to behold, isn't it...
Ensemble of Hope#094.dst: 자, 도착했다. 댐은 정말 볼 만하지 않아...
Ensemble of Hope#094.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#095.src: I- I always d..did wonder what it'd b- b- be like to... to t...take this elevator...
Ensemble of Hope#095.dst: 나, 나 늘 이 승강기를 타, 타, 타면 어떨지... 구, 궁금했어...
Ensemble of Hope#095.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#096.src: Well, you'll finally get your chance. Come on, let's just fight already.
Ensemble of Hope#096.dst: 드디어 기회가 왔네. 자, 그냥 싸우자.
Ensemble of Hope#096.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#098.src: What? We can't rush this? The longer we wait, the more suspicious they'll get.
Ensemble of Hope#098.dst: 뭐? 서두르면 안 돼? 오래 기다릴수록 저쪽만 더 의심할 거야.
Ensemble of Hope#098.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#102.src: Defeat the soldiers defending the elevator at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#104.src: Careful! Looks like they've got backup!
Ensemble of Hope#104.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#106.src: H...how many p- people can they fit in th- th- that elevator?!
Ensemble of Hope#106.dst: 저, 저 승강기에 사람이 대체 며, 몇, 몇 명이나 타는 거야?!
Ensemble of Hope#106.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#108.src: You're the insurgents everyone is on the lookout for! MEN, TO ARMS! CAPTURE THEM!
Ensemble of Hope#108.dst: 모두가 쫓는 반란분자들이 너희로구나! 전원, 무기를 들어라! 생포하라!
Ensemble of Hope#108.speaker: Wings Commander Kaezu

Ensemble of Hope#109.src: Talk to the group again at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#111.src: Sigh. Whatever. Let's go... get our people.
Ensemble of Hope#111.dst: 하아. 됐어. 가자... 우리 사람들 데리러.
Ensemble of Hope#111.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#114.src: Sui, are you INSANE?! You almost got SHOT!
Ensemble of Hope#114.dst: Sui, 너 미쳤어?! 화살 맞을 뻔했잖아!
Ensemble of Hope#114.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#116.src: You turned your back when there were enemies still around!! What do you think would have happened if we weren't here?
Ensemble of Hope#116.dst: 적이 아직 있는데 등을 돌려?! 우리가 없었으면 어떻게 됐을 것 같아?
Ensemble of Hope#116.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#118.src: Shot. If you were lucky, somewhere that wouldn't have killed - but after what they saw, would they have really taken that risk?!
Ensemble of Hope#118.dst: 화살 맞았지. 운 좋으면 안 죽을 데 맞았겠지만, 그 꼴을 본 놈들이 그런 위험을 감수했겠어?!
Ensemble of Hope#118.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#120.src: Sui, stop being so reckless. You're... you're strong, I get that, but... that doesn't mean you're invincible.
Ensemble of Hope#120.dst: Sui, 그렇게 무모하게 굴지 마. 넌... 강해, 알아, 근데... 그렇다고 무적은 아니야.
Ensemble of Hope#120.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#121.src: S...Sui, we don't w- want to l- lo- lose you too...
Ensemble of Hope#121.dst: S, Sui, 너, 너까지 이, 잃고 싶지 않아...
Ensemble of Hope#121.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#122.src: But if I'm not good enough, if I'm not f-fast enough, then- then- then I'll lose you, and- and I can't, I can't do that again, I-
Ensemble of Hope#122.dst: 근데 내가 부족하면, 내가 빠, 빠르지 못하면, 그럼- 그럼- 너희를 잃을 거고, 그건- 그건 또 못 해, 못 한다고, 난-
Ensemble of Hope#122.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#125.src: You don't need to prove yourself. You've always been good enough for us.
Ensemble of Hope#125.dst: 증명할 필요 없어. 넌 우리한테 늘 충분했어.
Ensemble of Hope#125.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#126.src: Whatever that- that Sovereign said to you, to make you think everything's that's happened to us is your fault? It's not true!
Ensemble of Hope#126.dst: 그- 그 군주가 무슨 말을 해서 우리한테 생긴 일이 다 네 탓이라고 생각하게 됐든, 그건 사실이 아냐!
Ensemble of Hope#126.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#127.src: Sui. Sui. Mora's death is not your fault!! We can blame the crown, blame the Sovereigns- hell, blame me for leaving him there!!!
Ensemble of Hope#127.dst: Sui. Sui. Mora가 죽은 건 네 탓이 아냐!! 왕실 탓, 군주들 탓- 젠장, 걔를 두고 온 내 탓을 해!!!
Ensemble of Hope#127.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#128.src: But it wasn't your responsibility to protect him. To protect us. We're a team - a family, and... and I don't want to see you burn yourself to ash like Syndra did.
Ensemble of Hope#128.dst: 걔를 지키는 건 네 책임이 아니었어. 우리를 지키는 것도. 우린 팀이야- 가족이고... Syndra처럼 네가 스스로를 재가 될 때까지 태우는 건 보기 싫어.
Ensemble of Hope#128.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#130.src: R...Rex is r- right, Sui. We can... f- fi- fight together, sh...shore up each o- oth... each other's w...weaknesses.
Ensemble of Hope#130.dst: R, Rex 말이 맞아, Sui. 우린... 가, 같이 싸우면서, 서, 서로의 야, 약점을 채워 줄 수 있어.
Ensemble of Hope#130.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#132.src: ...b- but we should pr...probably get going, Sui, b- before more backup sh...shows up.
Ensemble of Hope#132.dst: ...그, 그래도 지원군이 더 오기 전에 이, 이제 가야 할 것 같아, Sui.
Ensemble of Hope#132.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#133.src: Sigh. Zeph's right. You guys hurry to the Leaves, while we have the chance. {u} and I will prepare for your return.
Ensemble of Hope#133.dst: 하아. Zeph 말이 맞아. 기회 있을 때 얼른 잎새한테 가. {u}랑 난 너희 돌아올 준비를 할게.
Ensemble of Hope#133.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#135.src: Y... yeah. You're right, we should go too. Come on, let's meet at the Canopy's cave.
Ensemble of Hope#135.dst: 그... 그래. 네 말이 맞아, 우리도 가야지. 가자, 수관 동굴에서 만나.
Ensemble of Hope#135.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#136.src: A little. But... I don't know how else to get through to her.
Ensemble of Hope#136.dst: 조금. 근데... 걔한테 닿을 방법을 모르겠어.
Ensemble of Hope#136.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#137.src: It's so... frustrating! Seeing her taking on all of Syndra's worst traits! I- I know what to look out for, this time, but...
Ensemble of Hope#137.dst: 진짜... 답답해! Syndra의 제일 나쁜 점만 다 닮아 가는 걸 보니까! 이번엔- 뭘 조심할지는 아는데...
Ensemble of Hope#137.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#138.src: ...but I still don't know what to do.
Ensemble of Hope#138.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#139.src: Ha. Maybe I should apply my own advice to myself...
Ensemble of Hope#139.dst: 하. 내 충고나 내가 새겨들어야 하나...
Ensemble of Hope#139.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#140.src: We should get moving too. Come on, let's meet at the Canopy's cave.
Ensemble of Hope#140.dst: 우리도 출발하자. 가자, 수관 동굴에서 만나.
Ensemble of Hope#140.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#141.src: Travel to the {p} and find the Canopy in their new hideout at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#145.src: Oh, good grief. Look more closely, foxes - these are familiar faces! Or rather, familiar face, I should say - welcome back to the Canopy, {u}! And who might this be?
Ensemble of Hope#145.dst: 어머나, 세상에. 잘 봐요, 여우들 - 아는 얼굴이잖아요! 아니, 아는 얼굴 하나죠 - 수관에 돌아온 걸 환영해요, {u}! 그리고 이분은 누구시죠?
Ensemble of Hope#145.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#146.src: ...you're Captain Rurie, right? Sui told us about you.
Ensemble of Hope#146.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#147.src: Did she! Then that must mean you are one of the dear captured friends - no no, don't tell me, I can figure it out... Rex, I assume?
Ensemble of Hope#147.dst: 그랬어요! 그럼 붙잡혔던 소중한 친구 중 하나겠군요 - 아니 아니, 말하지 마요, 맞힐게요... Rex, 맞죠?
Ensemble of Hope#147.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#148.src: Hm... now, I would bring you in, but then Fuhue might have my head for not following her many numerous protocols... and we certainly can't have that...
Ensemble of Hope#148.dst: 음... 들여보내고 싶지만, 그러면 수많은 규정을 안 지켰다고 Fuhue가 내 목을 칠지도... 그건 곤란하죠...
Ensemble of Hope#148.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#149.src: Ugh, just let them in, Rurie. We've been breaking initiation protocols left and right already, I can't be bothered enforcing them anymore.
Ensemble of Hope#149.dst: 으, 그냥 들여보내요, Rurie. 입단 규정은 이미 여기저기 다 어겼어요. 이제 지키게 할 기운도 없어요.
Ensemble of Hope#149.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#150.src: Well, would you look at that! Lucky you! Come on in, come on in. Our numbers have grown since last you were here, {u} - many more friendly faces hanging about!
Ensemble of Hope#150.dst: 어머, 이것 좀 봐요! 운이 좋네요! 들어와요, 들어와. 지난번 이후로 식구가 늘었어요, {u} - 반가운 얼굴이 훨씬 많답니다!
Ensemble of Hope#150.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#151.src: {u}, Rex!! Man, it's good to see you guys!!
Ensemble of Hope#151.dst: {u}, Rex!! 와, 너희 보니까 진짜 좋다!!
Ensemble of Hope#151.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#152.dst: Yuman?! 여기서 뭐 해? 너 갇혀 있는 줄 알았는데-
Ensemble of Hope#152.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#153.src: In Deraj Prison, yup. Everything they say about it is true- and, and more! They get you workin' in the mines, if you're not... eh, y'know. Disappeared.
Ensemble of Hope#153.dst: Deraj 감옥에, 그래. 소문 전부 사실이더라- 아니, 그 이상! 안... 어, 알잖아. 사라지지 않으면 광산에서 굴려.
Ensemble of Hope#153.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#154.src: Lucky us, these Canopy guys showed up and broke us out! There were explosions, and growing plants, and crashing waves, and- and-
Ensemble of Hope#154.dst: 운 좋게 수관 사람들이 와서 우릴 빼내 줬어! 폭발에, 자라나는 식물에, 몰아치는 파도에, 그리고- 그리고-
Ensemble of Hope#154.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#155.src: And then the feathery birds showed up outta nowhere, like- nothing there, then poof, cloud of smoke, and there they are- and they got us outta there!
Ensemble of Hope#155.dst: 그리고 깃털 달린 새들이 갑자기 나타났어, 막- 아무것도 없다가, 펑, 연기 구름, 그리고 짠- 그리고 우릴 꺼내 줬지!
Ensemble of Hope#155.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#156.src: I'm sorry... Rurie. You all... successfully broke into Gravity's Monolith?! And got people out?!
Ensemble of Hope#156.dst: 잠깐만요... Rurie. 다들... 중력의 모놀리스에 쳐들어가는 데 성공했다고요?! 사람들까지 빼냈고요?!
Ensemble of Hope#156.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#157.src: Ah, it wasn't so tough once we had the plans of their inner workings! Floorplans, guard rotations... the works.
Ensemble of Hope#157.dst: 아, 내부 구조 도면만 손에 넣으면 그리 어렵지 않았어요! 평면도, 경비 교대... 전부 다요.
Ensemble of Hope#157.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#158.dst: 그 교도소장은 무시무시한 적이지만, 일과를 칼같이 지키죠 - 오후 {~}시만 되면 곯아떨어져요! 물론 감옥은 봉쇄되지만, 우리한텐 방법이 있죠.
Ensemble of Hope#158.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#160.src: Right you are Cileon, right you are... well, we'll have time to discuss the details later! I must return to my owls, there's much left to do!
Ensemble of Hope#160.dst: 맞아요 Cileon, 맞아요... 자, 자세한 건 나중에 얘기해요! 난 올빼미들한테 돌아가야 해요, 할 일이 많거든요!
Ensemble of Hope#160.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#162.src: Is, uh... is Zeph alright? I overheard a couple of things about what you two went through, so...
Ensemble of Hope#162.dst: 저, 어... Zeph는 괜찮아? 너희 둘이 겪은 일을 좀 들어서...
Ensemble of Hope#162.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#166.src: He's alright. He and Sui will be here later, so you can ask him about it yourself.
Ensemble of Hope#166.dst: 괜찮아. Sui랑 나중에 올 테니까 직접 물어봐.
Ensemble of Hope#166.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#167.src: Oh! Oh, ha, uh, alright- sure, that sounds good, yep.

Ensemble of Hope#167.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#168.src: I'm gonna... get back to my bro up there. Talk to ya more later!
Ensemble of Hope#168.dst: 난... 위에 있는 형제한테 가 볼게. 나중에 또 얘기하자!
Ensemble of Hope#168.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#170.src: I should talk to the Canopy's leader, get started on some planning. Come by when you're done talking with everyone, okay?
Ensemble of Hope#170.dst: 수관 지도자랑 얘기해서 계획을 시작해야겠어. 다들이랑 얘기 끝나면 와, 알았지?
Ensemble of Hope#170.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#172.src: Your friend has entered the hideout already, please make yourself at home.
Ensemble of Hope#172.dst: 친구는 이미 은신처에 들어갔다. 편히 있어라.
Ensemble of Hope#172.speaker: Canopy Fox

Ensemble of Hope#176.src: Ah, {u}. I'm glad to see you are well.
Ensemble of Hope#176.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#177.src: These have been... a difficult few weeks. For all of us, I gather. We have... been informed of our losses.
Ensemble of Hope#177.dst: 몇 주 동안... 힘들었지. 다들 그랬겠지만. 우리가 잃은 이들에 대해서도... 전해 들었네.
Ensemble of Hope#177.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#178.src: I still can't believe we let her talk us into... into all of that!
Ensemble of Hope#178.dst: 그 여자한테 설득당해서... 그 모든 걸 했다는 게 아직도 안 믿겨!
Ensemble of Hope#178.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#179.src: Yulie, let's not speak ill of the dead. We cannot change the past. We can only move forward.
Ensemble of Hope#179.dst: Yulie, 죽은 이를 욕하지 말게. 과거는 못 바꿔. 앞으로 나아갈 수밖에.
Ensemble of Hope#179.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#180.src: ...I, too, regret not standing my ground. For her sake, if nothing else.
Ensemble of Hope#180.dst: ...나도 버티지 못한 걸 후회하네. 다른 건 몰라도 그녀를 위해서.
Ensemble of Hope#180.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#181.src: Sigh... her grief and rage consumed her, in the end, and I did little to stop it. I- ahh- my back...
Ensemble of Hope#181.dst: 하아... 결국 슬픔과 분노가 그녀를 삼켰는데, 난 거의 막지 못했지. 나- 으- 허리가...
Ensemble of Hope#181.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#182.src: Quill, you need to rest. Sit down for a while, please.
Ensemble of Hope#182.dst: Quill, 쉬어야 해요. 제발 좀 앉아 있어요.
Ensemble of Hope#182.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#183.src: No, no... I'm fine, Yulie. We have work to do, after all.
Ensemble of Hope#183.dst: 아니, 아니... 괜찮네, Yulie. 할 일이 있지 않나.
Ensemble of Hope#183.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#184.src: Well, the guards at the prison didn't really care much about who was physically fit to work or not. They just... work you 'tll you're dead, I guess!
Ensemble of Hope#184.dst: 감옥 경비들은 누가 일할 몸인지 아닌지 신경도 안 썼어. 그냥... 죽을 때까지 부려 먹는 거지, 뭐!
Ensemble of Hope#184.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#185.src: Harsh treatment, certainly... but I suppose it is no different than the Roughworks, at its core. Only... less obscured.
Ensemble of Hope#185.dst: 가혹한 대우였지... 하지만 본질은 Roughworks와 다를 바 없을 걸세. 다만... 덜 감춰졌을 뿐.
Ensemble of Hope#185.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#187.src: {u}, Yusanu told us that he only made it through because of you and Sui. So... thank you. For protecting my little brother when I couldn't.
Ensemble of Hope#187.dst: {u}, Yusanu가 너랑 Sui 덕분에 버텼대. 그러니까... 고마워. 내가 못 할 때 내 남동생을 지켜 줘서.
Ensemble of Hope#187.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#188.src: Yes... thanks to yours and Sui's magic, I hear...
Ensemble of Hope#188.dst: 그래... 자네와 Sui의 마법 덕이라 들었네...
Ensemble of Hope#188.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#189.src: From the Steel Feather? The Canopy has quarters built deeper in these caverns. Anyone uninterested in fighting is staying there, for the time being.
Ensemble of Hope#189.dst: Steel Feather 사람들? 수관이 이 동굴 더 깊은 곳에 숙소를 지었어. 싸울 생각 없는 사람들은 당분간 거기 있어.
Ensemble of Hope#189.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#190.src: ...those we could find, at least. There are many we are still missing, unfortunately. I pray they are still alive.
Ensemble of Hope#190.dst: ...적어도 찾은 사람들은. 아직 행방을 모르는 이가 많아 안타깝네. 살아 있기를 기도할 뿐.
Ensemble of Hope#190.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#191.src: Perhaps when this is all over, we will be able to locate the rest... I can only hope so.
Ensemble of Hope#191.dst: 이 모든 게 끝나면 나머지도 찾을 수 있겠지... 그러길 바랄 수밖에.
Ensemble of Hope#191.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#192.src: ...so, look, if we try to charge these in this specific order-
Ensemble of Hope#192.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#193.src: No, wait. Your sequence is charging Thunder twice in a row here, when it should only do it once. Too much of a charge, and-
Ensemble of Hope#193.dst: 아뇨, 잠깐. 이 순서면 여기서 번개를 두 번 연속 충전해요. 한 번이어야 하는데. 너무 충전되면-
Ensemble of Hope#193.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#194.src: -and it'll destabilize, right. Thanks for double checking my work, Fuhue.
Ensemble of Hope#194.dst: -불안정해지겠지, 맞아. 다시 확인해 줘서 고마워, Fuhue.
Ensemble of Hope#194.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#195.src: ...oh, {u}??? I- I completely didn't... notice you were here...
Ensemble of Hope#195.dst: ...어, {u}??? 나- 여기 있는 줄 전혀... 몰랐어...
Ensemble of Hope#195.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#196.src: Yeesh. You've gotta fix your lack of awareness, bro. Anyone could sneak up on you while you're hyper focused in on something!
Ensemble of Hope#196.dst: 어휴. 그 둔한 거 좀 고쳐라. 뭐 하나에 푹 빠져 있을 땐 누가 몰래 다가와도 모르겠다!
Ensemble of Hope#196.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#197.src: Ugh, yeah, yeah, you keep telling me- if you're not going to be helpful, stop hovering!
Ensemble of Hope#197.dst: 으, 그래, 그래, 맨날 그 소리지- 도와줄 거 아니면 옆에서 얼쩡대지 마!
Ensemble of Hope#197.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#198.src: Nah. I wanna see the cool stuff happen when you get it working! Don't want to miss the fireworks or any-
Ensemble of Hope#198.dst: 싫어. 네가 성공할 때 멋진 거 보고 싶단 말이야! 불꽃놀이든 뭐든 놓치기 싫어-
Ensemble of Hope#198.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#199.src: To answer your question, {u}, Yusanu believes he has a working theory on the Resonance Weaver's functionality.
Ensemble of Hope#199.dst: 질문에 답하자면, {u}, Yusanu가 공명 직조기의 작동 원리에 대한 쓸 만한 가설을 세웠어요.
Ensemble of Hope#199.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#200.src: Yeah, but a working theory doesn't mean a whole lot if I can't get results...
Ensemble of Hope#200.dst: 그래, 근데 결과를 못 내면 가설이 무슨 소용이야...
Ensemble of Hope#200.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#201.src: Look, these five glyphs - they correspond almost exactly to the ones the Canopy's talismans use. Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Thunder.
Ensemble of Hope#201.dst: 봐, 이 문양 다섯 개 - 수관 호부에 쓰이는 거랑 거의 똑같아. 화염, 물, 대지, 바람, 번개.
Ensemble of Hope#201.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#202.src: They can be charged to activate them - a simple burst on its own, maybe, but if chained together... you get something more complex.
Ensemble of Hope#202.dst: 충전하면 작동해 - 하나만으론 그냥 한 번 터지겠지만, 연쇄로 이으면... 더 복잡한 게 나와.
Ensemble of Hope#202.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#203.src: Resonance... resonance, resonance, resonance... Soosu was always saying there was something she could not see with her blessing. Intangible, not of the elements...
Ensemble of Hope#203.dst: 공명... 공명, 공명, 공명... Soosu는 늘 자기 축복으로도 못 보는 게 있다고 했어. 형체가 없고, 원소도 아닌...
Ensemble of Hope#203.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#204.src: Maybe... if we could find it, we could use the Weaver to... to visualize it. Bind it in place, so we can see it...
Ensemble of Hope#204.dst: 어쩌면... 그걸 찾으면 직조기로... 눈에 보이게 할 수 있을지도. 제자리에 묶어서 보이게...
Ensemble of Hope#204.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#205.src: ...yeah, none of that made any sense to me. Explain it with easier words?
Ensemble of Hope#205.dst: ...응, 하나도 못 알아듣겠다. 쉬운 말로 해 줄래?
Ensemble of Hope#205.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#206.src: Okay, sure, just for you. Invisible thing in the air. With device, we make it visible.
Ensemble of Hope#206.dst: 그래, 좋아, 너만을 위해. 공기 속에 안 보이는 거. 장치로 보이게 함.
Ensemble of Hope#206.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#207.src: Oh! Why didn't ya start with that!
Ensemble of Hope#207.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#209.src: Ahem. Will we try the updated chain?
Ensemble of Hope#209.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#210.src: Right, right... got distracted. Thanks, Yuman.
Ensemble of Hope#210.dst: 그래, 그래... 딴 데 정신 팔렸네. 고맙다, Yuman.
Ensemble of Hope#210.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#214.src: I... I don't know, but... I think it's working! Fuhue, we did it!
Ensemble of Hope#214.dst: 나... 나도 몰라, 근데... 작동하는 것 같아! Fuhue, 해냈어!
Ensemble of Hope#214.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#215.src: Maybe if I touch it, something will...
Ensemble of Hope#215.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#218.src: And what, exactly, is this doing here? A blight that permeates the air... concerning. I'll have to speak to Master Azael.
Ensemble of Hope#218.dst: 대체 이게 왜 여기 있는 거죠? 공기에 스며든 역병이라... 걱정스럽네요. Azael 님께 말씀드려야겠어요.
Ensemble of Hope#218.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#219.src: Well, uh... now that it is here, can we do anything with it? Like... charge the glyphs to manipulate it?
Ensemble of Hope#219.dst: 그, 어... 이왕 여기 있는데 뭐 할 수 있는 거 없어? 뭐... 문양을 충전해서 조종한다든가?
Ensemble of Hope#219.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#220.src: M... maybe. I'll have to do some thinking. But for now, it'd probably be best to... get rid of it. If I hit all five at once, it should...
Ensemble of Hope#220.dst: 아, 아마도. 좀 생각해 봐야겠어. 근데 지금은... 없애는 게 제일 나을 거야. 다섯 개를 한꺼번에 치면...
Ensemble of Hope#220.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#221.src: ...there. Gods. Why did the Queen need this thing in the first place...?
Ensemble of Hope#221.dst: ...됐다. 세상에. 여왕은 대체 이게 왜 필요했던 거지...?
Ensemble of Hope#221.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#222.src: ...yeah, sure, why not. Later. I guess I've got to clean up here anyway.
Ensemble of Hope#222.dst: ...응, 그래, 좋아. 나중에. 어차피 여기 정리도 해야 하니까.
Ensemble of Hope#222.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#223.src: Seeing as... is that Rex over there? Oh, good. Well, seeing as she's plotting with Azael, I should get ready for that.
Ensemble of Hope#223.dst: 그러니까... 저기 Rex야? 아, 잘됐다. Azael이랑 계획을 짜고 있으니 난 그거 준비해야겠네.
Ensemble of Hope#223.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#224.src: Yuman, could you help me out? Since you've been annoying me all day.
Ensemble of Hope#224.dst: Yuman, 좀 도와줄래? 하루 종일 나 귀찮게 했으니까.
Ensemble of Hope#224.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#229.src: I've been looking forward to seeing you again, {u}. That is your real name, right?
Ensemble of Hope#229.dst: 다시 만날 날을 기다렸어요, {u}. 그게 진짜 이름 맞죠?
Ensemble of Hope#229.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#230.src: It feels like it's been ages since we last spoke. As you can probably guess, a lot has changed for me since then.
Ensemble of Hope#230.dst: 마지막으로 얘기한 게 까마득하네요. 짐작하겠지만, 그 뒤로 많은 게 달라졌어요.
Ensemble of Hope#230.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#231.src: After we took out Commander Ferreo, there was nowhere for me to go, but I knew I needed to leave the {p} and head somewhere I wouldn't be recognized.
Ensemble of Hope#231.dst: Ferreo 사령관을 처리한 뒤로 갈 곳이 없었지만, {p}을(를) 떠나 아무도 날 모를 곳으로 가야 한다는 건 알았죠.
Ensemble of Hope#231.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#232.src: I couldn't risk taking the train, so sneaking into the {p} at night was my only option. I had no idea what could be waiting for me there, but I had to go quickly, before they would start looking for me.
Ensemble of Hope#232.dst: 기차를 탈 순 없어서, 밤에 {p}에 숨어드는 게 유일한 방법이었어요. 거기 뭐가 있을지 몰랐지만, 날 찾기 시작하기 전에 서둘러야 했죠.
Ensemble of Hope#232.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#233.src: I took the easternmost exit out of the {p}, and by some miracle, snuck through to the {p} after quietly taking out a guard.
Ensemble of Hope#233.dst: {p}의 가장 동쪽 출구로 나가서, 조용히 경비병 하나를 처리하고 기적처럼 {p}에 숨어들었어요.
Ensemble of Hope#233.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#234.src: From there, I blindly stumbled across the region, terrified of what would find me. I was eventually knocked out by a Canopy scout, who took me into their hideout to be questioned.
Ensemble of Hope#234.dst: 거기서부터 무작정 이 지역을 헤맸어요. 뭐가 날 찾아낼지 두려워하면서요. 결국 수관 정찰병에게 기절당해 심문받으러 은신처로 끌려왔죠.
Ensemble of Hope#234.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#235.src: I told them the truth, about who I was, where I came from, and what I had done... They didn't believe me until I described you, and what you had done for me.
Ensemble of Hope#235.dst: 내가 누군지, 어디서 왔고 뭘 했는지 사실대로 말했어요... 당신과 당신이 해 준 일을 설명하기 전까진 안 믿더라고요.
Ensemble of Hope#235.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#236.src: Even after we split ways, you were still there to look out for me!
Ensemble of Hope#236.dst: 헤어진 뒤에도 당신이 날 지켜 주고 있었네요!
Ensemble of Hope#236.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#237.src: Of course, they didn't trust me immediately, I still had to prove myself. I've learned more here than I would have ever had at {p}.
Ensemble of Hope#237.dst: 물론 바로 믿어 주진 않았고, 날 증명해야 했어요. 여기서 {p}에서 평생 배울 것보다 더 많이 배웠어요.
Ensemble of Hope#237.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#238.src: And now, I can call myself a resistance member, same as you. I've thought a lot about my goals since we were recruits. I want Fruma to be rid of corruption, like what we saw with Commander Ferreo.
Ensemble of Hope#238.dst: 이제 나도 당신처럼 저항군이라 할 수 있어요. 신병 시절 이후로 목표를 많이 생각했어요. Ferreo 사령관 같은 부패가 Fruma에서 사라지길 바라요.
Ensemble of Hope#238.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#239.src: The resistance is the best chance we have at achieving this goal, I'm sure you've realised this too. I am ready to risk my life fighting for a better future for Fruma!
Ensemble of Hope#239.dst: 저항군이 그 목표를 이룰 최선의 기회예요. 당신도 알았을 거예요. Fruma의 더 나은 미래를 위해 목숨을 걸고 싸울 각오가 됐어요!
Ensemble of Hope#239.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#240.src: I could be saying the same thing, but the people here have told me that you can handle yourself just fine.
Ensemble of Hope#240.dst: 나도 같은 말을 할 수 있지만, 여기 사람들 말로는 당신은 알아서 잘한다더군요.
Ensemble of Hope#240.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#241.src: I must admit, my time with the resistance has been very difficult. But I can finally say I am fighting for a cause I truly believe in.
Ensemble of Hope#241.dst: 솔직히 저항군 생활은 정말 힘들었어요. 그래도 드디어 진심으로 믿는 대의를 위해 싸운다고 말할 수 있어요.
Ensemble of Hope#241.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#242.src: Deep down in my heart, I've always known I could never live up to the expectations my family had for me. Here, I no longer have to worry about that.
Ensemble of Hope#242.dst: 마음속 깊이, 가족의 기대에 절대 못 미친다는 걸 늘 알았어요. 여기선 더는 그걸 걱정 안 해도 돼요.
Ensemble of Hope#242.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#243.src: I was so alone, {u}, I truly can't thank you enough for being there for me...
Ensemble of Hope#243.dst: 난 너무 외로웠어요, {u}. 곁에 있어 준 것, 정말 뭐라 감사해야 할지...
Ensemble of Hope#243.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#244.src: You have nothing to be sorry for, I completely understand why you couldn't tell me the truth.
Ensemble of Hope#244.dst: 미안할 거 없어요. 진실을 말할 수 없었던 이유, 충분히 이해해요.
Ensemble of Hope#244.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#245.src: What matters the most is that you helped me escape {p} when you found out that I was in danger.
Ensemble of Hope#245.dst: 제일 중요한 건 내가 위험하단 걸 알고 {p}에서 탈출하게 도와줬다는 거예요.
Ensemble of Hope#245.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#246.src: ...and if we route through the tunnels - we have a couple options for city sectors...
Ensemble of Hope#246.dst: ...터널로 우회하면 - 도시 구역 선택지가 몇 개 있고...
Ensemble of Hope#246.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#247.src: Yes, I see. It would be worth your while to compare notes with Captain Fuhue, she can help narrow it down.
Ensemble of Hope#247.dst: 그래, 알겠소. Fuhue 대장과 의견을 맞춰 보는 게 좋겠소. 범위를 좁혀 줄 것이오.
Ensemble of Hope#247.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#248.src: ...ah, {u}. Young Rex and I were just speaking on our options moving forward. Would you like to join us for this discussion?
Ensemble of Hope#248.dst: ...아, {u}. 젊은 Rex와 앞으로의 선택지를 논하던 참이오. 함께 의논하겠소?
Ensemble of Hope#248.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#249.src: Well... go, then! Go talk to people, you have time.
Ensemble of Hope#249.dst: 그럼... 가 봐! 사람들이랑 얘기하고 와, 시간 있으니까.
Ensemble of Hope#249.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#250.src: Alright! So, {u}, here's the deal. If we want to take out the crown, we'll need to hit it at its root - the Queen, the Citadel, and her Royal Palace.
Ensemble of Hope#250.dst: 좋아! 자, {u}, 상황은 이래. 왕실을 무너뜨리려면 뿌리를 쳐야 해 - 여왕, 성채, 그리고 여왕의 왕궁.
Ensemble of Hope#250.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#251.src: We're not getting through the front gates, obviously... they're too defended. But we don't need to take the gates - we can come in from below.
Ensemble of Hope#251.dst: 당연히 정문으론 못 뚫어... 방어가 너무 탄탄해. 근데 문을 뚫을 필요는 없어 - 아래로 들어가면 되거든.
Ensemble of Hope#251.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#252.src: The caverns and catacombs beneath the Citadel are quite expansive. Captain Rurie has-
Ensemble of Hope#252.dst: 성채 아래 동굴과 지하 묘지는 상당히 넓소. Rurie 대장이-
Ensemble of Hope#252.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#253.src: Ah, was that my name I just overheard! We're speaking about the tunnels, are we? If you're hoping to traverse them, I'm the man for the job!
Ensemble of Hope#253.dst: 어머, 방금 내 이름 들렸죠! 터널 얘기 중이죠? 거길 지나가고 싶다면 내가 적임자예요!
Ensemble of Hope#253.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#254.src: It's quite an extensive network, really... the owls and I have spent years mapping each and every inch of it - and we still haven't seen it all! It's very interesting - and that's not to mention-
Ensemble of Hope#254.dst: 정말 방대한 망이에요... 올빼미들이랑 몇 년을 들여 구석구석 지도를 그렸는데 - 아직도 다 못 봤어요! 참 흥미롭죠 - 게다가-
Ensemble of Hope#254.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#255.src: Get to the point already, Rurie. They want to reach the Citadel through the tunnels. Is that possible?
Ensemble of Hope#255.dst: 요점만 말해요, Rurie. 터널로 성채까지 가고 싶대요. 가능해요?
Ensemble of Hope#255.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#256.src: Hmph. Possible, it certainly is... though results may vary. Looking for something in particular?
Ensemble of Hope#256.dst: 흥. 가능은 하죠... 결과는 장담 못 하지만. 딱히 찾는 곳 있어요?
Ensemble of Hope#256.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#257.src: Something easy to take, and easily defensible. University is out of the question... too large. The barracks are out of the question... maybe the Industrial Zone? Someone get me a map-
Ensemble of Hope#257.dst: 빼앗기 쉽고, 지키기 쉬운 곳. 대학은 말도 안 되고... 너무 커요. 병영도 안 되고... 산업 지구는? 누가 지도 좀-
Ensemble of Hope#257.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#258.src: If I- ahh- if I may interrupt... I believe the {p} should fit the criteria you are looking for.
Ensemble of Hope#258.dst: 내가- 으- 끼어들어도 된다면... {p}이(가) 찾는 조건에 맞을 것 같네.
Ensemble of Hope#258.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#259.src: It is closed off, and only lightly guarded in comparison to the rest of the Citadel... or, at least, it was in my time.
Ensemble of Hope#259.dst: 폐쇄된 곳이고, 성채 다른 곳에 비하면 경비도 허술하지... 적어도 내 시절엔 그랬네.
Ensemble of Hope#259.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#261.src: The {p}, you say? Yes... yes, I believe it could work! The path is long and winding, but should be plenty large enough to fit a strike team.
Ensemble of Hope#261.dst: {p} 말이에요? 그래요... 그래요, 될 것 같아요! 길은 길고 구불구불하지만, 공격대가 지나가기엔 충분히 넓을 거예요.
Ensemble of Hope#261.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#262.src: Good! Captain Rurie, would you be able to map out that route so we can-
Ensemble of Hope#262.dst: 좋아요! Rurie 대장, 그 경로를 지도로 그려 주시면-
Ensemble of Hope#262.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#266.src: Y...Yuman?! Y- you- you're here? Y...you're okay?
Ensemble of Hope#266.dst: Y, Yuman?! 너- 너 여기 있어? 괘, 괜찮은 거야?
Ensemble of Hope#266.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#267.src: 'Course I am, princess! What, were you worried?
Ensemble of Hope#267.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#268.src: Are you done? Weren't we here to plan our next moves?
Ensemble of Hope#268.dst: 다 했어? 다음 계획 세우러 온 거 아니었어?
Ensemble of Hope#268.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#270.src: So we're attacking the Citadel through the tunnels?
Ensemble of Hope#270.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#271.src: Indeed, we are. It seems we have decided on the {p}? We will take control of the sector to serve as a launching point for future operations.
Ensemble of Hope#271.dst: 그렇소. {p}(으)로 정한 듯하군? 그 구역을 점령해 이후 작전의 발판으로 삼을 것이오.
Ensemble of Hope#271.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#272.src: If that's the only thing we attack, won't the crown immediately realize what we're doing?
Ensemble of Hope#272.dst: 거기만 공격하면 왕실이 바로 눈치채지 않을까?
Ensemble of Hope#272.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#273.src: Hm... yeah, I guess you're right. We'll want to stage a few more attacks elsewhere, divert their attention...
Ensemble of Hope#273.dst: 음... 그래, 네 말이 맞아. 다른 곳도 몇 군데 공격해서 주의를 돌려야겠어...
Ensemble of Hope#273.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#274.src: We could launch an attack at the gates?
Ensemble of Hope#274.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#275.src: Wh- wh- what?! Sui, y...you can't just th- throw yourself at-
Ensemble of Hope#275.dst: 뭐, 뭐, 뭐라고?! Sui, 너 그, 그렇게 몸을 던지면-
Ensemble of Hope#275.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#276.src: Just enough to draw their attention! N-not to try and break through, obviously. We kill a few soldiers, then retreat.
Ensemble of Hope#276.dst: 주의만 끌 정도로! 뚫으려는 게 아, 아니고, 당연히. 병사 몇 명 죽이고 물러나는 거야.
Ensemble of Hope#276.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#277.src: If... if we can make them think we're trying the gates, then they won't see the group coming through the tunnels.
Ensemble of Hope#277.dst: 정문을 노리는 척... 속이면, 터널로 오는 쪽은 못 볼 거야.
Ensemble of Hope#277.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#278.src: Clever, indeed... I suppose we could spare some of our best fighters for such a task. Cileon, perhaps you might be interested?
Ensemble of Hope#278.dst: 영리하네요, 정말... 그런 일이라면 최고의 전사 몇을 보낼 수 있겠어요. Cileon, 관심 있어요?
Ensemble of Hope#278.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#280.src: Wonderful! Then I suppose it's settled? One team to the gates, one team through the tunnels- and, naturally, a team to handle communication-
Ensemble of Hope#280.dst: 좋아요! 그럼 정해졌죠? 한 팀은 정문, 한 팀은 터널- 그리고 물론 연락을 맡을 팀도-
Ensemble of Hope#280.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#281.src: Ahem- a moment of your time? Now, admittedly, I may be a tad outta my depth here- but y'all are talkin' a whole lot 'bout fighting?
Ensemble of Hope#281.dst: 크흠- 잠깐 괜찮나? 뭐, 솔직히 내가 낄 자린 아닐지도 모르지만- 다들 싸움 얘기만 잔뜩 하는구먼?
Ensemble of Hope#281.speaker: Kaio

Ensemble of Hope#282.src: And it seems to me you're disregarding somethin' quite vital. The crown sure ain't lacking in strength... it can always train up new folks to replace the lost. S'done it time n' time again.
Ensemble of Hope#282.dst: 근데 내가 보기엔 아주 중요한 걸 빼먹고 있어. 왕실은 힘이 모자라질 않아... 잃은 만큼 새로 키우면 그만이지. 몇 번이고 그래 왔고.
Ensemble of Hope#282.speaker: Kaio

Ensemble of Hope#283.src: But where the crown really lives and dies is the public opinion. Y'know, the whole... ehm, "ordeal" at the Roughworks Festival - it's caused a real stir in the people.
Ensemble of Hope#283.dst: 근데 왕실의 명줄은 여론에 달렸지. 알잖나, Roughworks 축제에서 있었던 그... 에, "소동" - 그걸로 민심이 꽤 들끓었어.
Ensemble of Hope#283.speaker: Kaio

Ensemble of Hope#284.src: Sovereigns turnin', public exe-... sigh. Public executions. The people ain't happy. Wouldn't take much to... push 'em over the edge.
Ensemble of Hope#284.dst: 군주가 돌아서고, 공개 처-... 하아. 공개 처형. 백성들 불만이 커. 조금만... 밀면 넘어갈 거야.
Ensemble of Hope#284.speaker: Kaio

Ensemble of Hope#285.src: Now, the crown's got the tools to deal with violence. What it don't got is the tools to deal with civil unrest, 'least not quickly. So it might do well to give that a go as well.
Ensemble of Hope#285.dst: 왕실은 폭력에 대처할 수단은 있어. 없는 건 민중 봉기에 대처할 수단이지, 적어도 빨리는 못 해. 그러니 그쪽도 시도해 볼 만하지.
Ensemble of Hope#285.speaker: Kaio

Ensemble of Hope#286.src: That... makes sense. Though, I'm not sure we have the means for something like that...
Ensemble of Hope#286.dst: 그건... 일리 있네. 근데 우리한테 그럴 수단이 있을지 모르겠어...
Ensemble of Hope#286.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#287.src: We could ask the Blossom of Blades.
Ensemble of Hope#287.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#288.src: What?! Ugh, no, they're useless. It was a miracle you got anything out of them the first time, Sui! Trying again is just gonna be a waste of effort.
Ensemble of Hope#288.dst: 뭐?! 으, 안 돼, 걔들 쓸모없어. 처음에 뭐라도 얻어 낸 게 기적이었다고, Sui! 다시 해 봤자 헛수고야.
Ensemble of Hope#288.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#289.src: No, it won't. Because it'll work. {u} and I, we can talk to them, we can... we can work something out.
Ensemble of Hope#289.dst: 아니, 안 그래. 될 거니까. {u}랑 내가 얘기해 볼게, 우리가... 어떻게든 해 볼게.
Ensemble of Hope#289.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#290.src: ...fine. If you want to try, fine. But when it doesn't work - which it won't - remember that I told you so.
Ensemble of Hope#290.dst: ...알았어. 해 보고 싶으면 해. 근데 안 되면 - 안 될 거지만 - 내가 말했다는 거 기억해.
Ensemble of Hope#290.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#291.src: Okay. So you've got two distractions. But you're forgetting the most important problem - there is a GOD to worry about. If she catches on, you're done for.
Ensemble of Hope#291.dst: 좋아. 교란책이 두 개네. 근데 제일 큰 문제를 잊었잖아 - 상대할 신이 있다고. 그녀가 눈치채면 끝장이야.
Ensemble of Hope#291.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#292.src: Y...yeah... We- we need a way t...to make sure she d- does- doesn't show up...
Ensemble of Hope#292.dst: 그, 그래... 우, 우린 그녀가 나, 나타나지 모, 못 하게 할 방법이 필요해...
Ensemble of Hope#292.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#295.src: A move with great risk, certainly. But one that solves our remaining problems if successful.
Ensemble of Hope#295.dst: 분명 큰 위험이 따르는 수요. 하지만 성공하면 남은 문제가 해결되오.
Ensemble of Hope#295.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#296.src: {u}, a...are you s- sure about this?
Ensemble of Hope#296.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#297.src: Well, then it's settled! To divert the crown's attention - a strike team at the gates, unrest from the gossip group, and {u} turning themself in!
Ensemble of Hope#297.dst: 그럼 결정됐네요! 왕실의 주의를 돌리려면 - 정문엔 공격대, 소문 모임은 소요를, 그리고 {u}은(는) 자수!
Ensemble of Hope#297.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#298.src: There are still several days to go before the {p} Festival... perhaps it could be wise to detail our- aah- our plans further in that time?
Ensemble of Hope#298.dst: {p} 축제까지 아직 며칠 남았네... 그동안 계획을- 으- 더 자세히 다듬는 게 현명하지 않겠나?
Ensemble of Hope#298.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#299.src: Indeed. Though, before we dismiss this strategy meeting... Yusanu, you have been hard at work on that stolen device, yes?
Ensemble of Hope#299.dst: 그렇소. 다만 이 작전 회의를 파하기 전에... Yusanu, 그 훔친 장치를 열심히 연구하고 있었지?
Ensemble of Hope#299.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#300.src: Yeah. I... think I know how it works, but it's... hard to operate - it's very abstract, needing to figure out which glyphs to activate to get an intended result-
Ensemble of Hope#300.dst: 네. 작동 원리는... 알 것 같은데, 다루기가... 어려워요 - 너무 추상적이라, 원하는 결과를 얻으려면 어떤 문양을 켤지 알아내야 하고-
Ensemble of Hope#300.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#301.src: But. One thing we managed to do was... reveal some invisible force in the air. {u} said it was... dangerous. And it's, uh... kind of everywhere.
Ensemble of Hope#301.dst: 그래도. 해낸 게 하나 있는데... 공기 속 보이지 않는 힘을 드러냈어요. {u}이(가) 위험하다고... 했고요. 그리고, 어... 어디에나 있어요.
Ensemble of Hope#301.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#302.src: I don't know why the Queen needed this device. But {u} said they might have an idea, and that they'd tell everyone here.
Ensemble of Hope#302.dst: 여왕이 이 장치를 왜 필요로 했는지 모르겠어요. 근데 {u}이(가) 짐작 가는 게 있어서 여기 모두에게 말해 준대요.
Ensemble of Hope#302.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#304.src: I said, so what? We already knew we were facing up against a god. We already knew that wasn't gonna be easy!!
Ensemble of Hope#304.dst: 그래서 뭐냐고. 신이랑 맞선다는 건 이미 알았잖아. 쉽지 않을 것도 이미 알았고!!
Ensemble of Hope#304.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#305.src: Y...yeah... It's a l- li... a little scary, h- hearing about... a- all that... but we can w...worry about it later, r- ri- right?
Ensemble of Hope#305.dst: 그, 그래... 그런 얘기 드, 듣는 건 조, 조금... 무섭긴 한데... 걱정은 나, 나중에 해도 되잖아, 그, 그치?
Ensemble of Hope#305.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#306.src: Doesn't really matter what she is. She's still going to die.
Ensemble of Hope#306.dst: 그녀가 뭐든 상관없어. 어차피 죽을 거니까.
Ensemble of Hope#306.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#307.src: It's good information to have. It'll help us formulate the specifics of our plans better. Master Azael, could I have a word with you?
Ensemble of Hope#307.dst: 알아 둘 만한 정보네요. 계획 세부를 짜는 데 도움이 될 거예요. Azael 님, 잠깐 말씀 좀 나눌 수 있을까요?
Ensemble of Hope#307.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#308.src: Ah, yes, certainly. Very well, everyone is dismissed. Get some rest, while you still can - these next few days will be very busy!
Ensemble of Hope#308.dst: 아, 그래, 물론이오. 좋소, 모두 해산. 쉴 수 있을 때 쉬어 두시오 - 앞으로 며칠은 몹시 바쁠 테니!
Ensemble of Hope#308.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#312.src: Sigh. This is all... going a bit over my head.
Ensemble of Hope#312.dst: 하아. 이거 다... 내 머리로는 좀 벅차.
Ensemble of Hope#312.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#313.src: Feels like everyone's forgotten why we tried to stay out of trouble for so long.
Ensemble of Hope#313.dst: 다들 우리가 왜 그렇게 오래 말썽을 피해 왔는지 잊은 것 같아.
Ensemble of Hope#313.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#314.src: We're making big plans to... storm the Citadel, take down the Crown, kill- kill an actual, living God!
Ensemble of Hope#314.dst: 성채를 급습하고, 왕실을 무너뜨리고, 진짜- 진짜 살아 있는 신을 죽이겠다는 거창한 계획이라니!
Ensemble of Hope#314.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#315.src: And... I don't know. It's too much. It's too risky. What are we going to do if it all fails?
Ensemble of Hope#315.dst: 그리고... 모르겠어. 너무 과해. 너무 위험해. 다 실패하면 어떡하려고?
Ensemble of Hope#315.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#316.src: Quill and I, we used to be the ones who considered that. Considered the safety of everyone in the Steel Feather.
Ensemble of Hope#316.dst: Quill이랑 나는 그런 걸 생각하던 사람이었어. Steel Feather 모두의 안전을.
Ensemble of Hope#316.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#317.src: And- and look, it sucks that Syndra died, it does. But I really wish she would have left us alone. She got Quill feeling guilty again, and...
Ensemble of Hope#317.dst: 그리고- 그래, Syndra가 죽은 건 슬프지, 정말. 근데 그냥 우릴 내버려 뒀으면 좋았을 텐데. Quill이 또 죄책감에 빠졌잖아...
Ensemble of Hope#317.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#318.src: And there's real stuff to feel guilty about. Of course there is. But there's nothing he can really do about it now. So that guilt isn't really serving a purpose anymore.
Ensemble of Hope#318.dst: 진짜 죄책감 느낄 만한 일도 있어. 당연히 있지. 근데 이제 와서 할 수 있는 게 없잖아. 그러니 그 죄책감은 더는 아무 의미가 없어.
Ensemble of Hope#318.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#319.src: ...whatever. At this point, I just have to keep my bros safe. I can't change anything else, so that's all that matters.
Ensemble of Hope#319.dst: ...됐다. 이제 난 동생들만 지키면 돼. 다른 건 못 바꾸니까, 그게 전부야.
Ensemble of Hope#319.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#321.src: It's... good to see you again, Sui. I- I'm glad you were able to find Rex and Zeph.
Ensemble of Hope#321.dst: 다시 만나서... 반가워, Sui. 네가 Rex랑 Zeph를 찾아서- 다행이야.
Ensemble of Hope#321.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#322.src: Yeah... it's good. I'm, um, glad you got your brothers back too.
Ensemble of Hope#322.dst: 응... 좋아. 나도, 음, 네가 형제들을 되찾아서 기뻐.
Ensemble of Hope#322.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#324.dst: 음... Yusanu. 나 하고 싶은 말이-
Ensemble of Hope#324.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#325.src: Hey. It's fine. You don't have to apologize for being upset after... y-yeah. And, it's not like I was exactly being helpful...
Ensemble of Hope#325.dst: 야. 괜찮아. 그 일 이후로 화났던 거 사과할 필요 없어... 그, 그래. 나도 딱히 도움이 된 것도 아니고...
Ensemble of Hope#325.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#326.src: So. It's alright. Water- ha- under the bridge, right?
Ensemble of Hope#326.dst: 그러니까. 괜찮아. 다- 하- 지난 일이잖아, 그치?
Ensemble of Hope#326.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#329.src: So, Yusanu, you've been... working on that device, right? How's that been?
Ensemble of Hope#329.dst: 그래서, Yusanu, 그 장치... 연구하고 있었지? 어때?
Ensemble of Hope#329.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#330.src: Slow... but, I think... I think I'm glad I've had it to work on? Because- because everything at the festival would've still... happened, without it.
Ensemble of Hope#330.dst: 느려... 근데, 있잖아... 이게 있어서 다행인 것 같아. 왜냐면- 이게 없었어도 축제 일은 어차피... 일어났을 테니까.
Ensemble of Hope#330.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#331.src: But instead, I've been able to focus on figuring it out instead of... everything else. So I'm glad I had it. I'm... glad we took it.
Ensemble of Hope#331.dst: 대신 다른... 모든 것 말고 이걸 알아내는 데 집중할 수 있었어. 그래서 다행이야. 우리가 이걸... 훔쳐 와서 다행이야.
Ensemble of Hope#331.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#332.src: ...that's good. I guess at least something came of it.
Ensemble of Hope#332.dst: ...잘됐네. 적어도 뭔가 얻은 게 있긴 하구나.
Ensemble of Hope#332.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#333.src: Could you, uh, show us the... thing? The- what did you call it, {u}? "Corruption?"
Ensemble of Hope#333.dst: 그, 어... 그거 좀 보여 줄래? 그- 뭐라고 했지, {u}? "타락?"
Ensemble of Hope#333.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#334.src: I can, just... one second. And don't touch it!!
Ensemble of Hope#334.dst: 보여 줄게, 그냥... 잠깐만. 그리고 절대 만지지 마!!
Ensemble of Hope#334.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#335.src: Hm... weird. And you're saying this is invisible everywhere?
Ensemble of Hope#335.dst: 음... 이상하네. 이게 어디에나 안 보이게 있다고?
Ensemble of Hope#335.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#336.src: I think so. That's kind of what Soosu was implying. Strands of it tied up in everything...
Ensemble of Hope#336.dst: 그런 것 같아. Soosu가 말하려던 게 이런 거였어. 모든 것에 얽힌 가닥들...
Ensemble of Hope#336.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#338.src: Oh. Oh. So that's what... I've been...
Ensemble of Hope#338.dst: 아. 아. 그럼 그게... 내가 봐 온...
Ensemble of Hope#338.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#339.src: The strands. I've been- I've been seeing them for a while, I just... didn't bring it up, because, ha, we had, um, more important, things, going on-
Ensemble of Hope#339.dst: 가닥들. 난- 한참 전부터 봤어, 그냥... 말을 안 했어, 왜냐면, 하, 우리한테, 음, 더 중요한, 일들이, 있었으니까-
Ensemble of Hope#339.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#340.src: Everything has them. They're not, um, unaffected by the- the raging ocean, but it's more like... like they are the ocean, and- and-
Ensemble of Hope#340.dst: 모든 것에 있어. 그게, 음, 그- 성난 바다에 영향을 안 받는 건 아닌데, 오히려... 그게 바다 자체인 것 같달까, 그리고- 그리고-
Ensemble of Hope#340.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#341.src: Sui, calm down. You're talking too fast.
Ensemble of Hope#341.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#342.src: I could recognize five of them. I- I usually pull on blue and sometimes white, for my- my magic, but- but- but anyway, I can see them, red-blue-green-white-yellow, but-
Ensemble of Hope#342.dst: 다섯 가지는 알아볼 수 있어. 나- 난 마법 쓸 때 보통 파랑, 가끔 하양을 당겨, 근데- 근데- 아무튼, 다 보여, 빨강-파랑-초록-하양-노랑, 근데-
Ensemble of Hope#342.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#343.src: But it's not just them, there- there was always something else, s-something different, something I could feel but couldn't see, and- a-and-
Ensemble of Hope#343.dst: 근데 그것만이 아니야, 거기- 늘 뭔가 다른 게 있었어, 뭐, 뭔가 달라, 느껴지는데 안 보이는 게, 그리고- 그, 그리고-
Ensemble of Hope#343.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#344.src: ...and it's that. Right there. That's the s-something, and- and you're saying it's... the Queen?
Ensemble of Hope#344.dst: ...그게 저거야. 바로 저기. 저게 그 뭐, 뭔가고, 그리고- 너희 말은 저게... 여왕이라고?
Ensemble of Hope#344.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#345.src: I- I- I thought {u} could see it too, and just... wasn't saying anything, so I n-never mentioned it, but... but. But you can't, can you?
Ensemble of Hope#345.dst: 나- 나- 난 {u}도 보이는데... 말을 안 하는 줄 알았어, 그래서 한, 한 번도 말 안 했는데... 근데. 근데 못 보는구나, 그치?
Ensemble of Hope#345.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#347.src: Oh, so... so it's just another thing wrong with me. Ha. Okay. That... makes sense. Of... of course.
Ensemble of Hope#347.dst: 아, 그럼... 그럼 그냥 나한테 이상한 게 또 하나 있는 거네. 하. 그래. 그럼... 말이 되네. 다... 당연하지.
Ensemble of Hope#347.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#349.src: It's not... something wrong with you, Sui. Your magic, it's strong, isn't it? Maybe this is just another part of it.
Ensemble of Hope#349.dst: 그건... 너한테 이상이 있는 게 아냐, Sui. 네 마법은 강하잖아? 이것도 그 일부일지 몰라.
Ensemble of Hope#349.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#350.src: Maybe. I... need to go think.
Ensemble of Hope#350.dst: 그럴지도. 나... 생각 좀 하고 올게.
Ensemble of Hope#350.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#353.src: I don't think anything we say is gonna get through to her right now. You saw it, she closed herself off at the end there.
Ensemble of Hope#353.dst: 지금은 우리가 무슨 말을 해도 안 들을 거야. 봤잖아, 마지막에 또 마음을 닫았어.
Ensemble of Hope#353.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#354.src: We can try again later, after she calms down a little. Maybe she'll be more receptive to you than she has been to me.
Ensemble of Hope#354.dst: 좀 진정하면 나중에 다시 해 보자. 나보단 너한테 더 마음을 열지도 모르고.
Ensemble of Hope#354.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#356.src: Hey, you, uh... didn't even flinch when I called you princess earlier! My charm must be wearing off, heh.
Ensemble of Hope#356.dst: 야, 너, 어... 아까 공주님이라고 불렀는데 꿈쩍도 안 하더라! 내 매력이 떨어졌나 봐, 헤.
Ensemble of Hope#356.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#358.src: Ah, y'know. My manly man charm! Cause I'm so cool, and strong, and talented, right?
Ensemble of Hope#358.dst: 아, 알잖아. 사나이다운 매력! 난 멋지고, 강하고, 재능 있잖아, 그치?
Ensemble of Hope#358.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#359.src: Hm... n...no, that d- doesn't sound right... I don't th...think y- you're any of those!
Ensemble of Hope#359.dst: 음... 아, 아니, 그건 아, 아닌데... 넌 그중 하, 하나도 아닌 것 같아!
Ensemble of Hope#359.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#360.src: Ouch! My heart, Zeph, my heart! I can't believe it... to think, I'm not cool or strong or talented... how will I ever live now?
Ensemble of Hope#360.dst: 아야! 내 심장, Zeph, 내 심장! 믿을 수가 없어... 내가 멋지지도 강하지도 재능 있지도 않다니... 이제 어떻게 살지?
Ensemble of Hope#360.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#367.src: Oh. I- I- uh, I m- m- missed you too...
Ensemble of Hope#367.dst: 아. 나- 나- 어, 나도 보, 보고 싶었어...
Ensemble of Hope#367.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#368.src: S...so... what team do y- you think you'll be on?
Ensemble of Hope#368.dst: 그, 그래서... 넌 어느 팀에 들어갈 것 같아?
Ensemble of Hope#368.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#369.src: Probably the main one in the tunnels, if I had to guess. Yulie's not gonna let me out of his sight, I bet.
Ensemble of Hope#369.dst: 짐작하자면 아마 터널 쪽 본대겠지. Yulie가 날 절대 눈앞에서 안 놓아줄걸.
Ensemble of Hope#369.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#370.src: O...okay. Just... b- be careful, okay?
Ensemble of Hope#370.dst: 아, 알았어. 그냥... 조, 조심해, 알았지?
Ensemble of Hope#370.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#371.src: Of course I will! Trust me. Cause, I've made up my mind...
Ensemble of Hope#371.dst: 당연하지! 믿어 봐. 왜냐면, 나 결심했거든...
Ensemble of Hope#371.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#372.src: Oh? Y...you managed to p- pr- produce a thought?
Ensemble of Hope#372.dst: 오? 네, 네가 생, 생각이란 걸 해 냈어?
Ensemble of Hope#372.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#373.src: Yep! First one ever, if you can believe it!
Ensemble of Hope#373.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#374.src: Heh. B...but, uh... t- tell me?
Ensemble of Hope#374.dst: 헤. 그, 그래서, 어... 마, 말해 줄래?
Ensemble of Hope#374.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#375.src: Nah. Not gonna spoil the surprise. You'll just have to wait and see, my prince.
Ensemble of Hope#375.dst: 싫어. 깜짝 선물을 망칠 순 없지. 기다려 봐, 나의 왕자님.
Ensemble of Hope#375.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#376.src: Hmph. After that last attack from the crown, it feels like you're getting just a touch too close to my kill count, Cileon!
Ensemble of Hope#376.dst: 흥. 왕실의 지난 공격 이후로 당신 처치 수가 내 기록에 너무 바짝 따라붙은 것 같네요, Cileon!
Ensemble of Hope#376.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#378.src: Cileon! My goodness, how rude of you! My thing has always been being the lethal sneaky assassin, lurking in the shadows...
Ensemble of Hope#378.dst: Cileon! 세상에, 무례하기도 하지! 내 전문은 늘 그림자에 숨어드는 치명적이고 은밀한 암살자라고요...
Ensemble of Hope#378.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#380.src: No no no, but it is true, my dear friend! Well, perhaps not the sneaky part... but the rest remains intact!
Ensemble of Hope#380.dst: 아니 아니 아니, 그래도 사실이에요, 친구! 뭐, 은밀한 부분은 아닐지 몰라도... 나머진 멀쩡하다고요!
Ensemble of Hope#380.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#381.src: Hm? Oh, Cileon? Yes, it's quite simple once you get to know them. With just a little bit of squinting, the meaning becomes perfectly clear!
Ensemble of Hope#381.dst: 네? 아, Cileon요? 네, 알고 지내면 아주 간단해요. 눈을 살짝만 가늘게 뜨면 뜻이 완벽히 보인답니다!
Ensemble of Hope#381.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#385.src: Ah, we have expanded quite a bit, haven't we? And in such short order too! Fuhue's protocols are in shambles right now!
Ensemble of Hope#385.dst: 아, 꽤 불어났죠? 그것도 이렇게 짧은 새에! Fuhue의 규정은 지금 엉망진창이에요!
Ensemble of Hope#385.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#386.src: But perhaps it's nice to let them fall by the wayside, for a time. We've met plenty of new friendly faces who would have never stood a chance otherwise!
Ensemble of Hope#386.dst: 그래도 잠시 규정 따위 내버려 두는 것도 좋죠. 안 그랬으면 기회도 없었을 반가운 새 얼굴을 잔뜩 만났으니까요!
Ensemble of Hope#386.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#387.src: So all's well that ends well, I suppose. Besides, with these plans of ours, any additional help is appreciated, yes?
Ensemble of Hope#387.dst: 끝이 좋으면 다 좋은 거죠. 게다가 우리 계획엔 조금이라도 더 도움이 필요하잖아요, 그렇죠?
Ensemble of Hope#387.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#389.src: Oh, quiet, you. You know just as well as I that we have a few days left! I don't need to be ready just yet, do I?
Ensemble of Hope#389.dst: 어머, 조용히 해요. 며칠 남은 거 당신도 나만큼 잘 알잖아요! 아직 준비 안 해도 되잖아요, 그렇죠?
Ensemble of Hope#389.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#390.src: But I suppose I'm ready for the coming challenge. I can't remember the last time I felt so excited for a mission to come! Goodness, what a rush.
Ensemble of Hope#390.dst: 그래도 다가올 도전에 준비는 된 것 같아요. 임무가 이렇게 설렌 게 언제였는지 기억도 안 나요! 세상에, 가슴이 뛰네요.
Ensemble of Hope#390.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#392.src: Ha! Gravity's Monolith, that little old thing? Simple and easy work... And, excuse me, you did NOT save me! I was perfectly capable of getting out of that situation myself, thank you!
Ensemble of Hope#392.dst: 하! 중력의 모놀리스, 그 낡은 거요? 쉽고 간단한 일이었죠... 그리고, 실례지만, 당신이 날 구한 거 아니거든요! 혼자서도 충분히 빠져나올 수 있었다고요!
Ensemble of Hope#392.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#393.src: I simply... ehm... wanted you to do something for once! Yes, silly Cileon, always on the... the back lines.
Ensemble of Hope#393.dst: 난 그냥... 에... 당신도 한 번쯤 뭘 좀 하길 바랐던 거예요! 그래요, 바보 Cileon, 늘... 늘 후방에만 있고.
Ensemble of Hope#393.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#395.src: Oh, don't look at me like that! Yes, yes, fine, I appreciate your help and support as always Cileon. Will that do?
Ensemble of Hope#395.dst: 어머, 그런 눈으로 보지 마요! 네, 네, 알았어요, 늘처럼 도와주고 지켜 줘서 고마워요 Cileon. 됐죠?
Ensemble of Hope#395.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#397.src: I did say this path'd only end in tragedy. Saw it comin' from a mile away.
Ensemble of Hope#397.dst: 이 길은 비극으로만 끝난다고 했지. 멀리서부터 보이더라고.
Ensemble of Hope#397.speaker: Kaio

Ensemble of Hope#398.src: 'Course, that don't make it any easier. No, it just makes it hurt more the last time you see 'em.
Ensemble of Hope#398.dst: 그렇다고 덜 힘든 건 아니지. 아니, 마지막으로 볼 때 더 아플 뿐이야.
Ensemble of Hope#398.speaker: Kaio

Ensemble of Hope#399.src: Synny... I knew she was linin' up to burn herself to ash. Hoped the kids could keep her goin', but. Well, y'know how it goes.
Ensemble of Hope#399.dst: Syn이... 스스로를 태워 재가 될 줄 알았어. 애들이 붙잡아 주길 바랐는데. 뭐, 다 알잖나.
Ensemble of Hope#399.speaker: Kaio

Ensemble of Hope#400.src: But Mora... now that'n hurts. Wasn't destined for nothin', should've had a long life lined up ahead of him.
Ensemble of Hope#400.dst: 근데 Mora는... 그건 아프구먼. 무슨 운명을 타고난 것도 아닌데, 앞에 긴 삶이 있었어야지.
Ensemble of Hope#400.speaker: Kaio

Ensemble of Hope#401.src: It's a damn shame. Always is. Always will be.
Ensemble of Hope#401.dst: 망할 안타까운 일이지. 늘 그랬고. 앞으로도 그렇겠지.
Ensemble of Hope#401.speaker: Kaio

Ensemble of Hope#402.src: Maybe you folks'll finally sort things through this time 'round. That'd sure be a nice surprise
Ensemble of Hope#402.dst: 이번엔 너희가 드디어 일을 매듭지을지도 모르지. 그럼 참 반가운 놀라움이겠구먼
Ensemble of Hope#402.speaker: Kaio

Ensemble of Hope#403.src: Ah... well, so it goes, so it goes. It'd be nice to be proven wrong, for once.
Ensemble of Hope#403.dst: 아... 뭐, 사는 게 그렇지, 그렇지. 한 번쯤은 내가 틀렸으면 좋겠구먼.
Ensemble of Hope#403.speaker: Kaio

Ensemble of Hope#404.src: You've got more folks to talk to, don't you? No need to waster your time on an old, bitter man like me.
Ensemble of Hope#404.dst: 얘기할 사람이 더 있잖나? 나 같은 늙고 꼬인 영감한테 시간 낭비할 필요 없어.
Ensemble of Hope#404.speaker: Kaio

Ensemble of Hope#406.src: These past few days, we have all been hard at work, preparing for our assault on the crown!
Ensemble of Hope#406.dst: 지난 며칠간 우리 모두 왕실 공격을 준비하느라 애썼소!
Ensemble of Hope#406.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#407.src: Tomorrow, the final Festival of the rotation will begin in full. As such, today, we must make our final preparations, lay out the plans, and get into positions.
Ensemble of Hope#407.dst: 내일, 이번 순환의 마지막 축제가 본격적으로 시작되오. 그러니 오늘 최종 준비를 마치고, 계획을 정리하고, 각자 위치로 가야 하오.
Ensemble of Hope#407.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#408.src: And, so... allow us to unveil Operation Godslayer!
Ensemble of Hope#408.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#409.src: We're splitting up into four groups, each with their own goals.
Ensemble of Hope#409.dst: 네 조로 나눠서 각자 목표를 맡아.
Ensemble of Hope#409.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#410.src: Group {~}! The strike team that'll assault the front gates, distracting the crown's forces from our real attack coming from below!
Ensemble of Hope#410.dst: {~}조! 정문을 공격하는 공격대야. 아래에서 오는 진짜 공격에서 왕실 병력의 눈을 돌리는 거지!
Ensemble of Hope#410.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#411.src: We need to avoid putting ourselves at risk, as much as possible, while still drawing the army's attention.
Ensemble of Hope#411.dst: 군대의 주의를 끌면서도 최대한 위험은 피해야 해.
Ensemble of Hope#411.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#412.src: I'll be leading the group, and I'm taking Sui, Zeph, and Cileon with me.
Ensemble of Hope#412.dst: 이 조는 내가 이끌고, Sui, Zeph, Cileon을 데려갈게.
Ensemble of Hope#412.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#413.src: My turn, then? Gourp {~}, we're taking the citadel's {p} by force! Through those neverending tunnels within the plateau, we'll strike where they least expect it!
Ensemble of Hope#413.dst: 내 차례죠? {~}조, 우린 성채의 {p}을(를) 무력으로 점령해요! 고원 안의 끝없는 터널을 지나, 가장 예상 못 할 곳을 칠 거예요!
Ensemble of Hope#413.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#414.src: We'll be taking most of our forces - Fuhue, Yuman, Yulie, as well as the rest of the Canopy.
Ensemble of Hope#414.dst: 병력 대부분을 데려가요 - Fuhue, Yuman, Yulie, 그리고 나머지 수관 전원.
Ensemble of Hope#414.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#415.src: Ah, I'll be handling our third group. We will be responsible for communications and intelligence. Once the second group completes their objective, we will join them.
Ensemble of Hope#415.dst: 아, 세 번째 조는 내가 맡겠네. 우리는 통신과 정보를 담당하지. 두 번째 조가 목표를 달성하면 합류할 걸세.
Ensemble of Hope#415.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#416.src: Yusanu, you are with me. And Captain Rurie, I will need your two best owls.
Ensemble of Hope#416.dst: Yusanu, 자넨 나와 함께. 그리고 Rurie 대장, 최고의 올빼미 둘이 필요하네.
Ensemble of Hope#416.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#417.src: And, lastly... {u}. Our fourth and final group. You, alone, will enter the citadel, with the aim of receiving an audience with the Queen.
Ensemble of Hope#417.dst: 그리고 마지막으로... {u}. 넷째이자 마지막 조요. 그대는 홀로 성채에 들어가 여왕을 알현하는 게 목표요.
Ensemble of Hope#417.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#418.src: Our plan hinges on your success... we need her, and as many Sovereigns as possible, distracted until our operation is completed.
Ensemble of Hope#418.dst: 계획의 성패는 그대에게 달렸소... 작전이 끝날 때까지 여왕과 최대한 많은 군주의 발을 묶어야 하오.
Ensemble of Hope#418.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#419.src: Once word of {u}'s capture reaches us, we will strike. We will assault the gates, and we will take control of a sector of the citadel!
Ensemble of Hope#419.dst: {u}이(가) 붙잡혔다는 소식이 오면 우리가 치겠소. 정문을 공격하고, 성채의 한 구역을 점령할 것이오!
Ensemble of Hope#419.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#420.src: For now, we will split up. Groups {~} and {~} will travel to {p}, and stay the night in preparation for tomorrow.
Ensemble of Hope#420.dst: 일단 흩어지겠소. {~}조와 {~}조는 {p}(으)로 가서 내일을 대비해 하룻밤 묵으시오.
Ensemble of Hope#420.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#421.src: {u}, we'll have to stop by the Blossom of Blades, too... We, um, need to see if we can get them to play their part.
Ensemble of Hope#421.dst: {u}, 칼날의 꽃에도 들러야 해... 걔들이, 음, 제 역할을 해 줄지 봐야 하니까.
Ensemble of Hope#421.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#422.src: Very well. That will be all! May fortune favour us on this coming day, and see us victorious in the end!
Ensemble of Hope#422.dst: 좋소. 이상이오! 다가올 날에 행운이 우리 편이길, 그리고 끝내 승리하길!
Ensemble of Hope#422.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#423.src: Meet Sui at the newspaper shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#425.src: I should inform you that if you are to fail, the rest of our operation will fall apart as well.
Ensemble of Hope#425.dst: 미리 말해 두는데, 당신이 실패하면 나머지 작전도 전부 무너져요.
Ensemble of Hope#425.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#426.src: So, don't mess up. No pressure.
Ensemble of Hope#426.dst: 그러니 망치지 마요. 부담 갖지 말고요.
Ensemble of Hope#426.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#429.src: Sigh... another day I'm not on the front lines. Maybe Sui was right...
Ensemble of Hope#429.dst: 하아... 또 전선에 못 나가는 날이네. Sui 말이 맞았나...
Ensemble of Hope#429.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#430.src: ... Whatever. I know I'm not the best fighter. So... I guess I'll do what I can from here.
Ensemble of Hope#430.dst: ... 됐다. 내가 잘 싸우는 편이 아닌 건 알아. 그러니... 여기서 할 수 있는 걸 해야지.
Ensemble of Hope#430.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#432.src: Man, I can't wait to get out there and kick some soldier ass!
Ensemble of Hope#432.dst: 와, 빨리 나가서 병사 놈들 엉덩이 걷어차고 싶다!
Ensemble of Hope#432.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#433.src: Ugh, can't tomorrow be here already? I'm sick of waiting around!
Ensemble of Hope#433.dst: 으, 내일 좀 빨리 안 오나? 기다리는 거 지겨워!
Ensemble of Hope#433.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#434.src: Uh... yeah? I can't stay stuck here in this little cave for the rest of my life! I got things to do, places to be!
Ensemble of Hope#434.dst: 어... 그럼? 평생 이 작은 동굴에 처박혀 있을 순 없잖아! 할 일도 있고, 갈 데도 있다고!
Ensemble of Hope#434.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#435.src: HUH!!! Pfft- uh- erm- huh- you-... how'd you, uh... know...?
Ensemble of Hope#435.dst: 허억!!! 풉- 어- 음- 헉- 너-... 어떻게, 어... 알았어...?
Ensemble of Hope#435.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#436.src: Goodness, back off to {p}, are you? I'm very happy not to be joining you, thank you very much.
Ensemble of Hope#436.dst: 세상에, {p}(으)로 돌아가요? 난 같이 안 가서 아주 기뻐요, 정말 고마워요.
Ensemble of Hope#436.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#437.src: But best of luck to you regardless! Find a good way to sneak Cileon in, eh?
Ensemble of Hope#437.dst: 그래도 행운을 빌어요! Cileon을 몰래 들여보낼 좋은 방법 찾아요, 네?
Ensemble of Hope#437.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#438.src: Well, as we will not be seeing each other until this concludes...
Ensemble of Hope#438.dst: 자, 이 일이 끝날 때까지 다시 못 볼 테니...
Ensemble of Hope#438.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#439.src: Good luck. We will have an owl shadowing you, so we will know when to proceed.
Ensemble of Hope#439.dst: 행운을 비오. 올빼미 한 마리가 뒤따를 테니 언제 움직일지 알 수 있을 것이오.
Ensemble of Hope#439.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#440.src: This is... quite the task you've signed yourself up for, isn't it?
Ensemble of Hope#440.dst: 이거... 꽤 큰 일을 자청했군, 그렇지 않나?
Ensemble of Hope#440.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#441.src: To think... you- aah- you're from beyond the province's walls. You have no stake in this conflict, and yet...
Ensemble of Hope#441.dst: 생각해 보면... 자넨- 으- 지방의 성벽 너머에서 왔지. 이 싸움에 걸린 것도 없는데, 그런데도...
Ensemble of Hope#441.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#442.src: ...well. We will forever be in your debt, if all goes to plan. I pray your mission will succeed.
Ensemble of Hope#442.dst: ...허허. 모든 게 계획대로 되면 우린 영원히 자네에게 빚을 지겠지. 임무가 성공하길 기도하네.
Ensemble of Hope#442.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#443.src: Hello again- You really do just keep catching me at the worst times.
Ensemble of Hope#443.dst: 또 뵙네요- 정말 늘 제일 곤란할 때 오시네요.
Ensemble of Hope#443.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Ensemble of Hope#444.src: The shop is all closed up for the night. Though, out of curiosity, did you happen to catch today's edition?
Ensemble of Hope#444.dst: 가게는 밤이라 문 닫았어요. 그런데 궁금해서 그러는데, 혹시 오늘 자 신문 보셨어요?
Ensemble of Hope#444.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Ensemble of Hope#445.src: I- oh dear! That's not formal conduct at all-
Ensemble of Hope#445.dst: 저- 어머나! 이건 전혀 예의가 아니잖아요-
Ensemble of Hope#445.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Ensemble of Hope#446.src: Ugh, we don't have time for this. Get out of the way.
Ensemble of Hope#446.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#447.src: -nothing to do with the news, I just wanted to ask if I could change my codename? Turns out my aunt just had a daughter named Heather, and-
Ensemble of Hope#447.dst: -뉴스랑은 상관없고, 코드네임 바꿔도 되는지 물어보려고요. 이모가 방금 딸을 낳았는데 이름이 헤더래서-
Ensemble of Hope#447.speaker: Violent Heather

Ensemble of Hope#448.src: Ah, put a pin that for a second? You two, latecomers? Water Grass, Shadow Bush, we have guidelines for these meetings-
Ensemble of Hope#448.dst: 아, 그 얘긴 잠깐 미뤄 줄래? 너희 둘, 지각이야? 물풀, 그림자 덤불, 이 모임엔 규칙이 있어-
Ensemble of Hope#448.speaker: Crimson Dagger

Ensemble of Hope#449.src: No, Crim, you put a sock in it! These two are banned from the Blossom!
Ensemble of Hope#449.dst: 아니, 진홍, 너나 입 다물어! 이 둘은 칼날의 꽃 출입 금지야!
Ensemble of Hope#449.speaker: Dusk Garden

Ensemble of Hope#452.src: These two were caught fighting Crown soldiers and openly resisting arrest nearby House Thalas! They're putting our whole operation at risk just being here!
Ensemble of Hope#452.dst: 이 둘은 Thalas 가문 근처에서 왕실 병사들이랑 싸우고 대놓고 체포에 저항하다 걸렸어! 여기 있는 것만으로 작전 전체가 위험해!
Ensemble of Hope#452.speaker: Dusk Garden

Ensemble of Hope#453.src: It's just like Toxic Thistle! They went gallivanting off who knows where, talking about much the same, and here we are in the same position- It can't happen again!
Ensemble of Hope#453.dst: 맹독 가시풀이랑 똑같아! 어딘지도 모를 데로 쏘다니며 비슷한 소리를 하더니, 우리가 또 같은 꼴이 됐잖아- 두 번은 안 돼!
Ensemble of Hope#453.speaker: Dusk Garden

Ensemble of Hope#454.src: Th-They- I was right?! Camellia, I was-
Ensemble of Hope#454.dst: 그, 그들이- 내 말이 맞았어?! 동백, 내가-
Ensemble of Hope#454.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Ensemble of Hope#455.src: Hush!! Hush, you're already on thin ice- Uh, wow! Really?
Ensemble of Hope#455.dst: 쉿!! 쉿, 너 이미 살얼음판이야- 어, 와! 정말?
Ensemble of Hope#455.speaker: Wilted Camellia

Ensemble of Hope#457.src: Excuse me?! Without us here, spreading the truth and keeping up with the times, the Resistance would-
Ensemble of Hope#457.dst: 뭐라고?! 우리가 여기서 진실을 퍼뜨리고 시류를 따라가지 않았으면, 저항군은-
Ensemble of Hope#457.speaker: Dusk Garden

Ensemble of Hope#458.src: We'd never even heard of you before we got here. You've been doing nothing!
Ensemble of Hope#458.dst: 여기 오기 전엔 너희 이름도 못 들었어. 아무것도 안 했잖아!
Ensemble of Hope#458.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#459.src: We were planning on asking you for help... but I guess that's out the window!
Ensemble of Hope#459.dst: 도와 달라고 할 생각이었는데... 다 틀렸네!
Ensemble of Hope#459.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#460.src: And at least we've got people that can do more than just... complain in a talentless editorial!!!
Ensemble of Hope#460.dst: 적어도 우리 쪽엔 재능 없는 사설에서... 불평만 늘어놓는 것보다 더 많은 걸 하는 사람들이 있어!!!
Ensemble of Hope#460.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#462.src: ...you know what? I thought Dusk might've been overreacting before, but after that? Yeah. You're not wanted here! Get out!
Ensemble of Hope#462.dst: ...있잖아? 아까는 황혼이 좀 과민하다 싶었는데, 그 말 듣고 나니? 그래. 너희는 여기 필요 없어! 나가!
Ensemble of Hope#462.speaker: Violent Heather

Ensemble of Hope#463.src: Openly flouting the Crown is a risk we can't take. Dusk Garden is right. I support the vote.
Ensemble of Hope#463.dst: 대놓고 왕실을 무시하는 건 감당 못 할 위험이야. 황혼 정원 말이 맞아. 난 표결에 찬성해.
Ensemble of Hope#463.speaker: Crimson Dagger

Ensemble of Hope#464.src: They were late, too. That's important.
Ensemble of Hope#464.speaker: Thorn Blade

Ensemble of Hope#465.src: So, you rabblerousers- For defying the Crown in such an unsafe way and jeopardizing our important work-
Ensemble of Hope#465.dst: 그러니, 이 선동꾼들- 이렇게 위험하게 왕실에 맞서 우리의 중요한 일을 위태롭게 한 죄로-
Ensemble of Hope#465.speaker: Dusk Garden

Ensemble of Hope#468.src: And for being late, you're hereby banned from the Blossom of Blades! Any objections?
Ensemble of Hope#468.dst: 그리고 지각한 죄로, 너희를 칼날의 꽃에서 추방한다! 이의 있어?
Ensemble of Hope#468.speaker: Dusk Garden
